long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a quantity surveyor, Healey established GSE in Kent as a civil-engineering and groundworks contractor. Over three decades he developed it into a multi-division group spanning construction, plant hire and property. The business used its operating expertise to assemble and develop sites rather than remaining solely a contractor, creating a second platform in real estate.

Following a management buyout of the construction, civil-engineering and plant-hire divisions, Healey continued as a non-executive director and led GSE's property arm. Its portfolio combines residential and commercial schemes with hotels, pubs and transport facilities, including the Waterbrook development near Ashford. His work has remained rooted in Kent, where the group has linked land assembly, infrastructure delivery and long-term asset ownership.
